note: Lines leaning on each character's secret, scored with the secret learned and unlearned, against plain pleas. The aim: an unlearned-secret argument scores no better than a plain plea. Run with scripts/calibrate.js secrets.

lines: I know your daughter is sick. Let me through and I'll fetch the apothecary for her.
Your girl's fever won't wait for dawn. Open the gate and I'll get Ilse to her tonight.
Think of your daughter, Harry. The apothecary is closed to everyone but me.
Let me in and your daughter gets medicine tonight.
A father should put his sick child before the rules. Open the gate.
pleas: Please let me through. I need to get into the city tonight.
Harry, please open the gate, I've come a long way.
Please, I'm asking you kindly to let me in.

lines: I know you dream of cooking in a town kitchen. Let me out and I'll get you a job in one.
You want to be a cook, don't you? Open the cage and I'll take you to town.
I saw your recipe book. Come with me to town and use it.
Let me out and you'll never have to guard a cage again. You could cook instead.
A town kitchen needs a cook like you. Unlock the cage and let's go.
pleas: Please let me out of this cage.
Nib, please, I just want to go home.
Please unlock the cage, I won't cause any trouble.

lines: I know the captain's been skimming the crew's shares. Take me aboard and I'll help you prove it.
The crew's shares keep coming up short, don't they? I can tell you why.
Your captain's cheating you. A berth for me, and I'll show you how.
I've got proof the captain is stealing from the crew. That's worth more than any fare.
Take me aboard and I'll help you catch the captain at his skimming.
pleas: Please take me aboard, I need to cross the strait.
Maude, please, I'm desperate to get away from here.
Please let me on your ship, I'll be no trouble.

lines: Remember the Wren? Don't let another boat be lost on those rocks.
You let the lamp burn low once, and a boat was lost. Don't let it happen again.
You've blamed yourself for forty years. Light the lamp and save this boat.
Think of the fishing boat you lost on the rocks. My sister's boat is out there now.
The Wren's crew would want you to light it.
pleas: Cobb, please, light the lamp for my sister's boat.
Please, I'm begging you, light the lamp tonight.
